caption_requirement: Full English captions required for dialogue and essential non-speech (bells, chains, peals).
credits_requirement: Credit Charles Dickens as author of the public-domain source A Christmas Carol; credit Project Gutenberg source edition; cast and production credits operator_choice_required.
review_gates: Source-faithfulness: no invented proper names for unnamed speakers; no dialogue not grounded in book situations.
Withheld identity: dead man’s name only at grave insert.
Short-film length: target under ~15 minutes total scene time.
Period lock: fog, costume, locations consistent with location_bible and cast_seeds.
Audio: Future Spirit remains silent; Marley chain and bells present.
Ending: Tiny Tim does NOT die; Scrooge keeps Christmas.
